description:
Create a ReqLLM scenario behavior/registry modeled on reqllm_next but adapted to req_llm. The contract should keep scenario id/name/description, applies?/1, run/3, deterministic fixture naming, structured result maps, and step metadata.

Constraints:
- Investigation/implementation belongs on v2/reqllm-next-architecture when started.
- Do not change provider runtime behavior.
- Preserve existing fixture names and tags.
- Add focused unit tests for fixture naming, applicability, result shape, and registry filtering.

Proof target: mix test test/req_llm/scenarios or equivalent new scenario test path.
title: Define ReqLLM scenario contract and registry
